"What's the cheapest you can do it for?"

When that's the first question on every call, you're being shopped on price, not hired on work.

On Bears LinkUp the customer sees your finished jobs — gates, railings, stairs, structure — before they ask for the estimate.

Veinte años de portones, rejas y escaleras. Y las fotos están en el celular.

O en un grupo de WhatsApp. O en la memoria del cliente que te recomendó — el único sitio donde el cliente nuevo no puede buscar.

En Bears LinkUp el trabajo terminado vive en el perfil del taller.

The resume says "welder." It doesn't say TIG, MIG or Stick, and it doesn't say what position.

So you find out on test day — after the schedule moved and the client is already waiting.

Bears LinkUp is only welders, fabricators and inspectors. Every profile shows process and position before you open it.

Creating your agency account is free. Link in bio.

Guys leave for Texas and start over. New shop, new test, nobody around who has seen their work.

The profile doesn't start over. Processes, positions and finished work travel with the account — and the platform reads in Spanish and in English.

Free to sign up. PR and the US. Link in bio.
